rules.title: Migrations only
rules.text: Change the schema only through versioned migrations that can run on production data.

rules.title: Index foreign keys and filters
rules.text: Index foreign keys and frequently filtered columns, and check query plans with EXPLAIN.

rules.title: Enforce constraints in the database
rules.text: Enforce NOT NULL, UNIQUE, CHECK and foreign key constraints in the schema.

rules.title: snake_case plural tables
rules.text: Name tables and columns in snake_case, with plural table names.

rules.title: Explicit transactions
rules.text: Wrap multi-statement changes in transactions and keep them short.
